## 0.7.0

patches.name: Always show publish date
patches.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches.name: Copy comments without username
patches.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.

patches.name: Diagnostic tools
patches.description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local TikTok crash capture.

patches.name: Disable login requirement
patches.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches.name: Disable long-press repost
patches.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches.description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches.name: Enable Live search
patches.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches.name: Feed tab navigation
patches.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches.name: Hide floating promotions
patches.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches.name: Open external links directly
patches.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches.name: Remember clear display
patches.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds the Metra patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches.name: Show seekbar
patches.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches.name: SIM spoof
patches.description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.

patches.name: Stop video looping
patches.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches.name: Translate comments
patches.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.
